component.name: Chronoclip
component.summary: Replay buffer for World of Warcraft on Linux

description.p: Chronoclip keeps the last minutes of your World of Warcraft gameplay in a rolling buffer and saves them as a video when you press a hotkey, like NVIDIA ShadowPlay's Instant Replay, but native to Linux.

ul.li: Always-on replay buffer of 5 to 45 minutes, oldest footage deleted automatically
Save with a global hotkey (Ctrl+F9 by default), the tray menu or the command line
Saving takes seconds: the video is copied, not re-encoded
GPU encoding with NVIDIA NVENC; the game keeps running smoothly
Only the game's own sound by default, optional microphone track
A chime and a notification tell you when a clip is saved

description.p: Chronoclip only records what your desktop shows through official X11 and sound server interfaces. It never touches the game process and sends nothing over the network. It currently needs an X11 session and an NVIDIA GPU.

screenshot.caption: Recording World of Warcraft, with the Save replay button and the last clip

description.p: First release: replay buffer, hotkey saves, game and microphone audio, notifications.
